timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹126.37 Cr (+24.6% YoY), net profit ₹14.57 Cr (+13.0% YoY).
Board of Directors, led by **Ankur Sharma**, recommended a final dividend of ₹1.50 per equity share (15% on ₹10 face value) for FY2025-26, pending 37th AGM approval on August 6, 2026.
GPT Healthcare reported Q4FY26 total revenue of ₹128.0 Cr (+24.3% YoY) and PAT of ₹14.7 Cr (+13.0% YoY).
GPT Healthcare Limited hosted a conference call on May 19, 2026, at 11:00 A.M. (IST) to discuss audited financial results for Q4 and FY 2025-26, with audio recording available via the provided link.
On May 19, 2026, GPT Healthcare held its Q4 FY26 earnings call, guiding for 15% revenue growth and 20% EBITDA margin in FY27.
